text: I went here to have my tartar removed, and the dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all.

text: I had my treatment at Dr. Suchada's clinic. The service was excellent, I was extremely impressed. She gave great advice. I will definitely come back every year.
author_name: ธนทัต อังสุภานิช

text: The doctor was very gentle and kind, and the equipment was clean.
The doctor has a very light hand.
author_name: วชิราพร ทารัตน์

text:
I don't know what kind of equipment they use here,
but it was the most painful teeth scaling I've ever had.
I walked out of the clinic with aching teeth all over my face.
And they did it so fast, no holding back at all.

author_name: สุมิตร วิชญานุภาพ
